# MODULE 6: CONSEQUENCES OF NON-COMPLIANCE  
## What Happens If You Don't Comply?  
### To FirstUK Bank  
**FCA Fines:**
- AML violations: Up to £10M+ per incident
- GDPR breaches: Up to €20M or 4% revenue
- Customer protection failures: Up to £50M+
- Recent example: HSBC fined £1.9B for AML failures  
**Regulatory Action:**
- Enforcement investigation
- Asset freezes
- License suspension
- Loss of banking license (extreme case)  
**Reputational Damage:**
- Media coverage
- Customer loss
- Investor confidence drop
- Business disruption

raw_entities.name: Module 6 — Consequences of Non-Compliance
raw_entities.description: A training module that educates staff on the regulatory, financial, and reputational consequences of failing to comply with AML, GDPR, and customer protection obligations. The module covers FCA fines, regulatory enforcement actions, and real-world examples of major penalties imposed on financial institutions.
context: What Happens If You Don't Comply?
AML violations: Up to £10M+ per incident
Recent example: HSBC fined £1.9B for AML failures

raw_entities.name: Understanding FCA Fine Thresholds for AML Violations
raw_entities.description: Staff must understand the financial penalties imposed by the FCA for AML compliance failures, including the scale of fines (up to £10M+ per incident) and real-world enforcement examples.
context: AML violations: Up to £10M+ per incident
Recent example: HSBC fined £1.9B for AML failures

raw_entities.name: Understanding GDPR Breach Penalties
raw_entities.description: Staff must understand the financial penalties imposed for GDPR data protection breaches, including the maximum fine of up to €20M or 4% of annual revenue.
context: GDPR breaches: Up to €20M or 4% revenue

raw_entities.name: Understanding Customer Protection Failure Penalties
raw_entities.description: Staff must understand the financial penalties imposed for customer protection failures, including fines up to £50M+.

raw_entities.name: Recognising Regulatory Enforcement Actions
raw_entities.description: Staff must understand the range of regulatory enforcement actions that can follow non-compliance, including enforcement investigations, asset freezes, license suspension, and in extreme cases, loss of banking license.

raw_entities.name: Understanding Reputational Damage from Non-Compliance
raw_entities.description: Staff must understand the broader reputational and business consequences of non-compliance, including media coverage, customer loss, investor confidence decline, and business disruption.

raw_entities.name: AML Compliance Obligation
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank staff must comply with AML regulations to avoid FCA fines of up to £10M+ per incident and regulatory enforcement action including asset freezes and license suspension.
context: AML violations: Up to £10M+ per incident

raw_entities.name: GDPR Data Protection Compliance Obligation
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank staff must comply with GDPR requirements to avoid fines of up to €20M or 4% of annual revenue and regulatory enforcement action.
context: GDPR breaches: Up to €20M or 4% revenue

raw_entities.name: Customer Protection Compliance Obligation
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank staff must maintain customer protection standards to avoid FCA fines of up to £50M+ and regulatory enforcement action.
